description:
Get organization billing overview

Returns the selected organization’s billing subscription and entitlementsVersion. The subscription can be null. Read the returned plan, charges and entitlements to inspect organization billing; this operation does not purchase or change a plan.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/organization-billing/get-organization-billing-overview
name: getOrganizationBillingOverview

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: When the plan's fees for an interval come to less than amountCents, the difference is invoiced at the end of the period.

amountCents.description: Least the plan bills each interval, in whole cents.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: Known values: ["graduated","standard","volume"]. Others may be added.

anyOf.description: Decimal amount in the plan currency. Kept as text so sub-cent unit prices remain exact.

currentPeriod.description: Charges so far this billing period, for an organization that pays by invoice; null for one that pays by card, or while its projects are still being moved to its billing day.

entitlementsVersion.description: Bumps on every entitlement change for the organization.

subscription.description: The organization-owned subscription, or null when billing was never opened or has ended.

estimatedTotalCents.description: What the period's invoice comes to if usage stops now and the units held are kept to the period's end: with tax, after discounts and credit.

periodEnd.description: Last moment of the billing period, ISO 8601. Its invoice is drafted on the billing day after.

periodStart.description: Start of the billing period, ISO 8601.

transferBalanceCents.description: Bank transfers received beyond every open invoice. They pay the next invoice once it is issued.

usageCents.description: Metered usage so far this period, across the organization and every project, before tax.

usageLimitCents.description: The contract's soft usage limit, compared with usageCents. Nothing is blocked at it; null when the contract sets none.

baseAmountCents.description: The plan's recurring base fee in whole cents.

cancelsAt.description: When the subscription will end, ISO 8601.

currentPeriodEnd.description: End of the current billing period, ISO 8601.

fixedCharges.description: Fixed charges defined by the organization's current plan. Quantity is the plan default.

planName.description: The plan's customer-facing name, e.g. Messaging Pro.
